'''Pala Kwi'teksa''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] and a student of [[Madame Vansitt's Charm Academy]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].

==Biography==
At the Charm Academy, Kwi'teksa was trained in the arts of etiquette and formality, as well as espionage and assassination. She became friends with [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Kitster Chanchani Banai]] at an early age.<ref name="The Hunt For Anakin Skywalker">''[[Episode I Adventures 6: The Hunt for Anakin Skywalker]]''</ref>

In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], Kwi'teksa was sold to [[Tantos]], a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] who was interested in using her as a [[Spy/Legends|spy]] and personal [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]]. At the same time, [[Sebulba/Legends|Sebulba]] arrived on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] to take part in a [[Podracing/Legends|podrace]]. Additionally, he had brought with him several young [[Ghostling]]s that he planned to sell to [[Gardulla Besadii the Elder/Legends|Gardulla]].<ref name="Capture Arawynne">''[[Episode I Adventures 7: Capture Arawynne]]''</ref>

Kwi'teksa and her friends freed the children and tried to transport them to safety. However, a group of trackers including Sebulba, [[Khiss (Dug)|Khiss]], [[Djas Puhr/Legends|Djas Puhr]] and [[Gondry]], pursued them. Kwi'teksa and the children were eventually chased through Gardulla's gardens. Although Khiss was killed, they were captured and sentenced to death by Gardulla.<ref name="Capture Arawynne" /><ref name="Trouble on Tatooine">''[[Episode I Adventures 8: Trouble on Tatooine]]''</ref>

Due to the efforts of [[Dorn (Bothan)|Dorn]] and [[Jira/Legends|Jira]], the children managed to escape and Pala Kwi'teksa and the ghostlings escaped the planet.<ref name="Trouble on Tatooine" />
